snippet.title: Shuffle Farm Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703910

A roguelike deckbuilder where farming meets the arcane. Build powerful synergies, master production chains, explore uncharted lands, and face formidable challenges - all with the help of a mysterious god. Or just chill and plant some crops... you can do that too!


Music:
"Wholesome" and "Constancy Part One" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
